ov: Scaly reptiles, usually with four legs, with over 7,000 species. They range from a 13.5 mm nano-chameleon to the 3 m Komodo dragon, and many can drop their tails to escape predators.

why.dg: Most lizards are harmless, but the Komodo dragon has attacked and occasionally killed people.
why.et: Green iguanas are eaten in Central America, and spiny-tailed lizards in Africa.
why.p: Many species are kept as pets, including bearded dragons, iguanas, anoles and leopard geckos.

rg: Every continent except Antarctica, and most oceanic island chains.
df: Mainly carnivorous: small species eat insects and other invertebrates, larger ones bigger prey. Some eat plants.
fx: Numerous lizards are kept as pets, including bearded dragons, iguanas, anoles and leopard geckos.
